# FMOD Ex

SolarFlare used FMOD Ex for audio.

The recovered deposit contained the following files under `Source/External/FMOD/`:

```text
include/
  fmod.h
  fmod.hpp
  fmod_codec.h
  fmod_dsp.h
  fmod_errors.h
  fmod_memoryinfo.h
  fmod_output.h
lib/
  gcc-linux/
    libfmodex.a
  vs2005/
    fmodex_vc.lib
```

It also contained the runtime under `Source/SolarFlare/`:

```text
fmodex.dll
```

The header and DLL identify version 4.22.6.

These third-party files were removed from the working copy. The terms applicable
to this historical version are unknown. The historical build is consequently
incomplete.

Upstream: [FMOD](https://www.fmod.com/) and [FMOD legal information](https://www.fmod.com/legal).
Current releases and terms may differ from those of FMOD Ex 4.22.6.
